facts.text: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.
facts.why: No opened source mentions a crab or crab people gag in the film. The plot has the spring break beach stakeout instead.
facts.fix: Serve the crab when Schmidt and Jenko hit the beach for spring break.

vibe.verdict: The college dining hall suits the film, but it is plain and misses the Ghost, WHY-PHY and the end credits sequels.
missing: WHY-PHY ('Work hard? Yes. Play hard? Yes.')
Schmidt's slam poetry date with Maya (the art class)
Mr. Walters and Eric in prison
The Ghost and Mercedes at the spring break bar
The golf cart chase into the football game
ideas: Swap 'Fried pickles with ranch' for 'WHY-PHY' punch served in a cup
Replace 'Cold Corona with lime' note with 'Puerto Mexico, still on the job'
Swap 'Dining hall pan choc chip cookie' for a slam poetry sundae
Replace the ticket cue with the spring break beach cue
